answer:
The world’s biggest (and most powerful) aircraft carrier in active service is **USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN‑78)**.  
It is named in honor of **Gerald Ronald Ford**, the 38th President of the United States, who served in the U.S. Navy during World War II.
